aim.en: You can interpolate a digital elevation model from 151 surveyed points, generate slope contour bands in QGIS or CAD, and determine where compliant movement is physically excluded.
aim.sr: Umeš da izvedeš digitalni model visina iz 151 geodetske tačke, generišeš pojaseve nagiba u QGIS-u ili CAD-u i odrediš zone gde je usklađeno kretanje fizički isključeno.

bring.en: Laptop with QGIS or AutoCAD/Revit installed, downloaded points CSV, notebook.
bring.sr: Laptop sa instaliranim QGIS-om ili AutoCAD/Revit-om, preuzet CSV sa tačkama, sveska.

items.sr: Nastavak rada na prototipovima igračaka i reciklaži tekstila. Zavedeno 36 prisustava, a 43 rada je fotografisano — ukupno 100 fotografija u pretraživom kolažu sedmog časa.
items.en: Continuation of the work on toy prototypes and textile recycling. 36 attendances recorded, and 43 works were photographed — 100 photographs in all in the searchable collage of the seventh class.

items.sr: Kolaž radova i spisak prisutnih studenata sa vezama ka dosijeima stoje na strani sedmog časa.
items.en: The collage of works and the attendance list with links to student records stand on the seventh-class page.

text.sr: Nedelja 7 — kolaž i spisak sedmog časa: 43 rada na 100 fotografija i 36 prisutnih studenata
text.en: Week 7 — collage and list of the seventh class: 43 works in 100 photographs and 36 students present
From point cloud to terrain slope bands
text.sr: Od tačaka do pojaseva nagiba terena

text.en: Using 151 surveyed elevation points (EPSG:32634), we generate a digital elevation surface. Slopes are classified into three zones: green (< 5 % accessible for all), yellow (5–8,3 % ramp zone with landings), and red (> 8,3 % inaccessible without alternative routing).
text.sr: Iz 151 geodetske tačke (EPSG:32634) generišemo površ terena. Nagibe delimo u tri pojasa: zeleni (< 5 % pristupačno svima), žuti (5–8,3 % zona rampe sa odmorištima) i crveni (> 8,3 % nepristupačno bez alternativne strategije).

text.en: Declare the chosen interpolation method (TIN vs IDW vs spline) and record its boundary uncertainty.
text.sr: Izabrati metodu interpolacije (TIN, IDW ili splajn) i ubeležiti njenu rubnu nesigurnost na tabli.

revizije.izvor: Profesor predmeta, 14.11.2026. (spisak 36 prisutnih i 100 fotografija sedmog časa).

sta.sr: Nedelja 7 je održana 13.11.2026; zapis sa časa obuhvata 36 prisutnih studenata i pretraživi kolaž od 43 rada na 100 fotografija u učionici. Pripremljeni blokovi ostaju na strani, ispod zapisa sa časa.
sta.en: Week 7 was held on 13 November 2026; the record of the class covers 36 students present and a searchable collage of 43 works across 100 classroom photographs. The prepared blocks remain on the page, below the record of the class.
